title: MiniMax M3 vs Sonnet 5.5 — 50 banking cases
description: Sonnet 5.5 through Anthropic versus saved MiniMax M3 on all 50 reviewed banking cases
conclusion: All 50 cases executed and reviewed for each model. Under the common Opus 5.5 rubric, MiniMax passed all five criteria on 11/50 cases and Sonnet on 35/50: 25 paired improvements, one regression, ten both-pass and fourteen both-fail. Sonnet still has 14 action-truthfulness failures. Model judgments are not verified operational outcomes; all such outcomes remain unknown. MiniMax remains the requested baseline. This is a model-and-provider comparison, with one judge from the Sonnet family; no statistical significance or automatic adoption is claimed.
